name: @effy/email-kit
description: Effy email system — the SSOT for every message the platform sends (specs/038-email-template-system). Templates are authored in MJML and compiled AT BUILD TIME into committed, drift-guarded artifacts; the palette is GENERATED from @effy/design-system's tokens.css. The `.` entrypoint is pure (catalogue + render, no AWS, no I/O) so preview and every test run with zero cloud access; `./send` is the only place an SES client exists.
